translations.web: For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
translations.bsb: For behold, the LORD comes forth from His dwelling place; He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
translations.kjv: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
translations.asv: For, behold, Jehovah cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
